title: BreezeSpawner
description: BreezeSpawner is a plugin which adds a Breeze spawner specially dropped from ominus vaults
body:
BreezeSpawner — Paper/Bukkit Plugin
Tired of grinding out MK1 Breeze farms the old-fashioned way? Say hello to BreezeSpawner — the smarter, faster way to automate your Breeze grind.


Features
  Ominous Vault Drops
BreezeSpawners have a 15% drop chance from Ominous Vaults, making every raid worth the risk. The more you loot, the more you grow your farm.

  Silk Touch Compatible
Mine your BreezeSpawner with a Silk Touch pickaxe and pick it right back up — no more losing your spawners when relocating your build.

  High Spawn Rate
Optimized for maximum mob output, so your XP and loot farms run at full efficiency without the wait.

Installation
Drop the .jar into your /plugins folder and start/restart your server

Discord-.cobraxsnitch

Enjoy!
